label: Sarajevo
why: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand catches the European empires and their colonial holdings at their largest extent, on the eve of the war that ends four of them.

realms.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
realms.note: Map id england used for the United Kingdom as England's successor state. British India (direct rule), crown colonies and protectorates are counted as held by it; dominions and protected states are listed separately with overlord england. Irish Home Rule crisis at its height.

realms.name: French Republic
realms.note: Third Republic; Algeria administered as départements; protectorates over Morocco, Tunisia, Annam, Cambodia, Laos.

realms.name: German Empire
realms.ruler: Wilhelm II, German Emperor (Chancellor Theobald von Bethmann Hollweg)
realms.note: Federal empire proclaimed 18 Jan 1871; its member states are listed with overlord germany. Colonies (East Africa, South-West Africa, Kamerun, Togo, Pacific) held by the Reich.

realms.name: Austria-Hungary
realms.ruler: Franz Joseph I (Emperor of Austria, King of Hungary)
realms.note: Dual Monarchy since the 1867 Compromise; Hungary is a co-equal kingdom, not a vassal, and is counted inside this realm. Heir Archduke Franz Ferdinand assassinated in Sarajevo this day.

realms.name: Russian Empire
realms.note: Map id muscovy used for the Russian Empire. Includes Congress Poland, the Baltic and Caucasus governorates and Russian Turkestan.

realms.name: Kingdom of Italy
realms.note: Kingdom of Sardinia (Savoy) renamed on unification, 17 Mar 1861. Holds Libya, Eritrea, Italian Somaliland and (occupied since 1912) the Dodecanese. Settimana Rossa unrest earlier in June.

realms.name: United States of America
realms.note: Holds the Philippines, Puerto Rico, Hawaii, Panama Canal Zone; occupying Veracruz since 21 Apr 1914.

realms.name: Empire of Japan
realms.note: Map id japan; Korea annexed 1910, Taiwan since 1895, Kwantung leased territory.

realms.name: Ottoman Empire
realms.ruler: Mehmed V (power with the CUP: Talat, Enver, Djemal Pasha)
realms.note: Lost Libya (1912) and most of Rumelia (1913); retook Edirne in July 1913. Nominal suzerain of Egypt and Cyprus.

realms.name: Kingdom of Spain
realms.note: Map id castile used for Spain. Holds Ceuta, Melilla, the northern Moroccan protectorate zone, Canaries, Río de Oro, Spanish Guinea.

realms.name: Kingdom of the Netherlands
realms.ruler: Queen Wilhelmina (PM Pieter Cort van der Linden)
realms.note: Government sits at The Hague. Holds the Dutch East Indies, Suriname, Curaçao.

realms.name: Republic of China
realms.note: Qing abdicated 12 Feb 1912. Yuan governs under the Constitutional Compact of May 1914; provinces under military governors; Outer Mongolia and Tibet de facto lost.

realms.name: Kingdom of Prussia
realms.note: Map id brandenburg used for Prussia, the dominant member state of the German Empire (Rhineland, East Prussia, Posen, Silesia, Schleswig-Holstein, Hanover).

realms.name: Dominion of Canada
realms.ruler: George V (Governor General Prince Arthur, Duke of Connaught; PM Robert Borden)
realms.note: Self-governing dominion since Confederation, 1 Jul 1867.

realms.name: Commonwealth of Australia
realms.ruler: George V (Governor-General Ronald Munro Ferguson; PM Joseph Cook)
realms.note: Federated 1 Jan 1901; parliament sits in Melbourne pending Canberra.

realms.name: Union of South Africa
realms.ruler: George V (Governor-General Viscount Gladstone; PM Louis Botha)
realms.note: Union of 31 May 1910; Pretoria administrative, Cape Town legislative capital.

realms.name: Persia (Qajar)
realms.ruler: Ahmad Shah Qajar (crowned 21 Jul 1914 on coming of age)
realms.note: Divided into Russian (north) and British (south-east) spheres by the 1907 convention; Russian troops in Tabriz and the north.

realms.name: Republic of the United States of Brazil
Argentine Republic
realms.ruler: Victorino de la Plaza, acting for the ailing President Roque Sáenz Peña

realms.name: Kingdom of Bavaria
realms.note: Map id bavaria. Member state of the German Empire with its own army and railways.

realms.name: Kingdom of Saxony
realms.note: Member state of the German Empire.

realms.note: Member state of the German Empire.

realms.name: Grand Duchy of Baden
realms.note: Member state of the German Empire.

realms.name: Grand Duchy of Mecklenburg-Schwerin
realms.note: Member state of the German Empire.

realms.name: Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg
realms.note: City-state of the German Empire.

realms.name: Free and Hanseatic City of Lübeck
realms.note: City-state of the German Empire.

realms.name: Kingdom of Belgium
realms.note: Independent since 1830; neutrality guaranteed by the 1839 Treaty of London. Holds the Belgian Congo (annexed 1908).

realms.name: Grand Duchy of Luxembourg
realms.note: Neutral since 1867; personal union with the Netherlands ended 1890; in the German customs union.

realms.name: Swiss Confederation
realms.ruler: Federal Council (President of the Confederation Arthur Hoffmann)
realms.note: Map id switzerland; federal state since 1848.

realms.name: Portuguese Republic
realms.ruler: President Manuel de Arriaga (PM Bernardino Machado)
realms.note: Republic since 5 Oct 1910; holds Angola, Mozambique, Portuguese Guinea, Goa, Macau, Timor.

realms.name: Kingdom of Denmark
realms.note: Holds Iceland (home rule), Greenland, Faroes, Danish West Indies.

realms.name: Kingdom of Norway
realms.note: Union with Sweden dissolved 7 Jun 1905.

realms.name: Grand Duchy of Finland
realms.ruler: Nicholas II as Grand Duke (Governor-General Franz Albert Seyn)
realms.note: Autonomous grand duchy under russification pressure.

realms.name: Kingdom of Serbia
realms.ruler: Peter I (Crown Prince Alexander regent from 24 Jun 1914; PM Nikola Pašić)
realms.note: Doubled in size after the Balkan Wars (Kosovo, Vardar Macedonia).

realms.name: Kingdom of Montenegro
realms.note: Kingdom since 1910; gained part of the Sanjak in 1913.

realms.name: Tsardom of Bulgaria
realms.note: Autonomous principality 1878, independent 5 Oct 1908; lost the Second Balkan War.

realms.name: Kingdom of Romania
realms.note: United Principalities of Wallachia and Moldavia (1859), independent 1878, kingdom 1881; took Southern Dobruja in 1913.

realms.name: Kingdom of Greece
realms.note: Gained Macedonia, Epirus, Crete and the Aegean islands in 1912–13.

realms.name: Principality of Albania
realms.note: Independence proclaimed 28 Nov 1912; prince installed Mar 1914 under great-power guarantee; facing a peasant revolt and Greek-backed Northern Epirus autonomy.

realms.name: Principality of Monaco
realms.note: Under French protection (1861 treaty).

realms.name: Principality of Liechtenstein
realms.note: Close customs and postal ties with Austria.

realms.name: Principality of Andorra
realms.ruler: Co-princes: the President of France and the Bishop of Urgell (Joan Benlloch i Vivó)

realms.name: Khedivate of Egypt
realms.ruler: Khedive Abbas II Hilmi (British Agent and Consul-General Lord Kitchener)
realms.note: De jure Ottoman vassal; under British military occupation since 1882 and in fact run by Britain. Britain declared a protectorate in Dec 1914. Co-ruler of Anglo-Egyptian Sudan.

realms.name: Zaydi Imamate of Yemen
realms.note: Autonomy in the highlands under the 1911 Treaty of Daan; Ottoman garrison in Sanaa.

realms.name: Emirate of Nejd and Hasa
realms.note: Took al-Hasa from the Ottomans in 1913; accepted the title of Ottoman wali of Nejd in a May 1914 treaty that was never fully implemented.

realms.name: Sheikhdom of Kuwait
realms.note: British protection by the secret 1899 agreement; the 1913 Anglo-Ottoman convention (unratified) called it an autonomous Ottoman kaza.

realms.name: Sultanate of Muscat and Oman
realms.note: Map id oman. Under strong British influence (informal protectorate). The interior Imamate revolt began in 1913.

realms.name: Emirate of Afghanistan
realms.note: Foreign relations controlled by Britain (Treaty of Gandamak 1879) though internally independent; overlord left null.

realms.name: Khanate of Khiva
realms.note: Russian protectorate since 1873; Turkmen revolts in 1912–1916.

realms.name: Emirate of Bukhara
realms.note: Russian protectorate since 1868/1873.

realms.name: Hyderabad State
realms.note: Largest Indian princely state, under British paramountcy.

realms.name: Kingdom of Mysore
realms.note: Princely state under British paramountcy.

realms.name: Jammu and Kashmir
realms.note: Map id kashmir. Princely state created by the 1846 Treaty of Amritsar.

realms.name: Dhar State
realms.note: Maratha princely state in the Central India Agency; Mandu lies within it.

realms.name: Kingdom of Nepal
realms.note: Real power with the hereditary Rana prime ministers; close to Britain but not a protectorate.

realms.name: Kingdom of Bhutan
realms.note: Foreign relations guided by Britain under the 1910 Treaty of Punakha.

realms.name: Tibet (Ganden Phodrang)
realms.note: Map id tibet. Expelled Chinese troops 1912–13, declared independence in Feb 1913; China's claim unresolved (Simla talks, convention initialled Jul 1914).

realms.name: Bogd Khanate of Mongolia
realms.note: Map id mongols used. Independent from 29 Dec 1911; China claims it; Russian-backed. The 1915 Kyakhta treaty later reduced it to autonomy under Chinese suzerainty.

realms.name: Kingdom of Siam
realms.note: Map id ayutthaya used for Siam (Chakri dynasty); Ayutthaya town itself lies within it.

realms.name: Empire of Annam (Nguyễn)
realms.note: Map id dai_viet. French protectorate over Annam; Tonkin a separate protectorate, Cochinchina a colony.

realms.name: Kingdom of Cambodia

realms.name: Kingdom of Luang Prabang

realms.name: Sultanate of Johor

realms.name: Sultanate of Brunei

realms.name: Raj of Sarawak

realms.name: Sultanate of Ternate

realms.name: Ethiopian Empire

realms.name: Republic of Liberia

realms.name: Beylik of Tunis

open_questions: Realm ids follow the map-id rule for continuing states (england = United Kingdom, castile = Spain, muscovy = Russia, brandenburg = Prussia, ayutthaya = Siam, khmer = Cambodia, dai_viet = Annam, mongols = Bogd Khanate); the event-tree files instead use britain, russia, ottoman. Germany and Italy use new ids (germany, italy) rather than brandenburg or savoy.

German member states (Prussia, Bavaria, Saxony, Lübeck) are given as holders with overlord germany; a check that wants the federal level should credit germany for Berlin, Cologne, Königsberg, Munich, Dresden and Lübeck.
Austria-Hungary is one realm (austria); Hungary is not listed separately as it was a partner in a dual monarchy rather than a vassal. Buda is therefore held by austria.
British India is counted as held directly by england (no separate british_raj realm); princely states (Hyderabad, Mysore, Kashmir, Dhar) and Bhutan are protected realms with overlord england.
Egypt is listed with overlord ottomans (de jure); in practice Britain governed it. Cyprus (Nicosia) is given to england though formally Ottoman until Nov 1914.

Mexico is one realm under Huerta although the Constitutionalists (Carranza, Villa, Obregón) and Zapatistas held most of the country; Tzintzuntzan (Michoacán) and Mayapán (Yucatán) are low-certainty as to which faction controlled them on this date.
Tibet and Mongolia are given as independent; China claimed both, and Mongolia accepted Chinese suzerainty in 1915.
Afghanistan, Oman, Cuba and Nicaragua have overlord null despite British or US control of foreign affairs or rights of intervention.

since_previous was recomputed against 1815.json in the id harmonisation (the Kingdom of Italy keeps savoy, the Qing are jurchens); argentina, paraguay and haiti already existed in 1815 and are not in formed. Short-lived realms that came and went (Gran Colombia, the Central American Federation, Texas, the Confederacy, the Peru–Bolivian Confederation) are not listed.
Names of some rulers of minor realms (Dhar, Ternate, Honduras, El Salvador acting president) are from general knowledge and not re-verified.

Id harmonisation: the Kingdom of Italy uses savoy (legal continuation of the Kingdom of Sardinia), Argentina continues the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata, Afghanistan the Durrani state, the Grand Duchy of Hesse uses hesse_darmstadt (Hesse-Kassel ended 1866). The Republic of China is counted as a new state (china formed), with the Qing (jurchens) ended.

Added as still standing: Hungary and Bohemia within Austria-Hungary, Indian princely states carried from 1815 (Jaipur, Udaipur, Jodhpur, Cooch Behar, Kolhapur, Manipur, Travancore, Baroda, Gwalior, Indore), Kalat, Lahej, Bornu, Brunswick, Oldenburg, Sulu, Tidore, the Mutapa rump and the Hejaz. Ended entries never listed in 1815 (German Confederation, Zulu, Transvaal, Orange Free State) were dropped.
